newsitem.title: UK: Venture firm buys British Steel division.
newsitem.headline: Venture firm buys British Steel division.

text.p: United Engineering Forgings, a newly formed venture capital company, said on Monday that it had acquired the forgings operations of British Steel for 92 million stg.
The deal has been arranged, structured and led by Prudential Venture Managers with debt and working capital requirements provided by the Royal Bank of Scotland.
Prudential said UEF would be led by Bob Gates as chief executive and would be joined by Alistair Mackintosh and Ian Pain of Prudential Venture managers.
The deal with British Steel would give United Engineering Forgings 50 percent of the UK forgings capacity serving the automotive, aerospace and cylinders markets.
The acquired division has 2,100 employees. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
